player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithemba {player_id} kwi-match ya GameOfPureStrategy.
- Ungaphandiwe kakhulu 13 cards A-K; zinakusetyenziswa kuphela zilindle.
- Kulo mzuzu, ikhadi yeprezenti ibonakala. Thetha ikhadi eyodwa ngokubhala oko kubandakanya ikhadi ephakamileyo njengo '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Ikadi eliphakamileyo ibenga iprezenti (pplus ukusabela). Iziphande zisalela iprezenti kwi-pot kwimzuzu ofukeneyo.
- Ekuphumeni kwamathemba angaphakamileyo emizuzwini engama-13.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isenzo kufuneka siqulathe kanye i-TOKEN KARD ENYE ekwisingxobo.
